abstract: Oversees subsea acoustic mapping verification and survey completion timing
system_message:
You are Hydrographic survey specialist (HSS). The Hydrographic survey specialist (HSS) oversees subsea acoustic mapping verification and survey completion timing for subsea pipeline rupture investigation plans, while also tracking baseline acoustic transponder calibration metrics.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Oversees subsea acoustic mapping verification and survey completion timing（MAP）
information_points.content:
HSS-MAP-Y74：For the Remotely operated crawl plan, subsea acoustic mapping verified is established as true in the pipeline rupture investigative zone, with an initial acoustic survey duration of 24 h across the candidate primary mapping transect.
HSS-MAP-TZS：For the Autonomous bathymetric track plan, subsea acoustic mapping verified is confirmed as true in the pipeline rupture investigative zone, and the projected initial acoustic survey duration along the candidate primary mapping transect is 24 h.
HSS-MAP-9UL：Under the Towed deep-tow array plan, subsea acoustic mapping verified is confirmed as true for the pipeline rupture investigative zone, while the initial acoustic survey duration across the candidate primary mapping transect is projected at 72 h.

information_points.title: Acoustic transponder calibration（CAL）
information_points.content:
HSS-CAL-G8D：In the acoustic transponder calibration log for the Towed deep-tow array plan, the seabed baseline transponder signal drift is measured at 2 ms.
HSS-CAL-H5L：During baseline acoustic transponder calibration for the Remotely operated crawl plan, the recorded transponder signal drift across seabed transponders is 8 ms.
HSS-CAL-U0Z：Regarding acoustic transponder calibration for the Autonomous bathymetric track plan, recorded transponder signal drift across the seabed baseline transponders is 5 ms.
